en: A black-and-white photograph of a historic waterfront with multiple two- and three-story buildings lining a harbor. The structures reflect Venetian and Ottoman architectural styles, with a visible minaret on the left, suggesting Islamic influence. In the foreground, calm sea water; in the background, hilly terrain. There is Greek, French, and possibly English text indicating the name and a brief description of the area.
